source: See the per-field "provenance" map below (B0.4) -- unlike the other configs in this directory, most of this file's numbers do NOT come from a manufacturer manual. Only a handful of facts about this engine are public as of Sep 2025: it is a 2.2L 4-cylinder inline turbocharged CRDi diesel with a FADEC, built by VRDE with Jayem Automotives, rated at 180 hp (~134.2 kW) at 11,000 ft, operable to 32,000 ft, and it raises TAPAS BH-201's indigenous content to ~80%. See Indian Defence News (2025-08-24) and idrw.org (2025-08-24), both cited in docs/audit/08_deployable_system_blueprint.md Sec 0 and docs/build/DECISIONS.md D01. Everything else here (bore/stroke/CR, rail pressure, turbo boost curve, BSFC, lambda, injection timing, fuel cold-flow properties, mass, TBO...) is an engineering assumption scaled from comparable 2.0-2.2L automotive CRDi engines (e.g. the OM640-class block the Austro AE300 licenses) and MUST be replaced with VRDE-supplied data before being quoted as fact -- this is precisely the list of what we need FROM VRDE (docs/audit/10_red_team_readiness_review.md Sec 3, "what do you need from us?").

manufacturer.ref: Indian Defence News 2025-08-24; idrw.org 2025-08-24 -- 'developed by VRDE in partnership with Jayem Automotives'

platforms.ref: TAPAS BH-201 confirmed by both sources above. Archer-NG and other platforms were listed in an earlier version of this file without a source and have been removed pending confirmation -- see docs/build/RESEARCH_LEDGER.md Sec 4.

fuel.ref: Jet-A1 is the standard defence heavy-fuel/single-fuel-policy choice (docs/audit/07 Sec II) but was not itself stated in the public sources; not contradicted by anything found

ignition_mode.ref: 'CRDi' (common-rail direct injection) in the public sources implies compression ignition; not stated explicitly as such

layout.bore_mm.ref: scaled from OM640-class 2.0-2.2L 4-cyl CRDi blocks -- NOT VRDE-confirmed

layout.stroke_mm.ref: scaled from OM640-class 2.0-2.2L 4-cyl CRDi blocks -- NOT VRDE-confirmed

layout.displacement_cc.ref: '2.2L' is public (Indian Defence News 2025-08-24); the exact cc figure (2179) is back-calculated from the assumed bore/stroke above, not independently sourced

layout.compression_ratio.ref: typical CRDi CR range; no source

turbo.critical_altitude_ft.ref: no source -- do not confuse with the public 32,000 ft operating ceiling, which is an airframe/engine ceiling, not the turbo's boost-hold altitude

turbo.intercooled.ref: standard practice at this boost level; not confirmed

rated_power_kw.ref: 180 hp = 134.23 kW -- Indian Defence News 2025-08-24 and idrw.org 2025-08-24 both give 180 hp; the ALTITUDE at which this is rated (11,000 ft) is public but this config schema has no field for rating altitude -- do not present this as a sea-level rating

tbo_hours.ref: matches the other configs' 2000h default; not VRDE-confirmed

rail_pressure_bar.ref: typical for a modern CRDi system in this class; not VRDE-confirmed

fuel_cloud_point_c.ref: Jet-A1 / DEF STAN 91-091 typical spec values

fuel_cfpp_c.ref: Jet-A1 / DEF STAN 91-091 typical spec values
